title: Bots
description: Connect platform accounts to your agents and configure how requests are handled.
empty_hint: Create a bot with platform accounts, agents and routing rules. Existing integrations remain available in Settings.
delete_description: Its platform connections will stop. Existing agents, chats and tasks will be kept.
discard_description: Your changes to this bot have not been saved.
senders_hint: Incoming senders appear automatically, deduplicated within each platform account. Allowlist entries are used only when the allowlist is enabled.
senders_empty: Send a message to this bot to discover accounts.
name: Bot name
platforms_hint: Each account has its own credentials and connection host. The host receives and sends messages; execution can use a different machine.
remove_platform: Remove account and its exclusive routes
keep_secret: Leave blank to keep the saved secret
identity_hint: To use a different app, add an account. Updating the secret keeps the existing conversations.
routes_hint: The first matching rule is used. All specified conditions must match. If no rule matches, use the default agent and execution settings.
routes_empty: All requests use the default agent.
matching_accounts_hint: Leave all unchecked to match any account.
allowlist_hint: Off by default. When enabled, only allowlisted senders can directly create Issues through this bot. Other actions remain available.
candidates_failed: Could not load agents or Runtimes. Reload the page to try again.
notifications_hint: Choose which account sends Issue updates and which group receives them.
unsupported: This bot uses configuration that this version cannot edit.
runtime_incompatible: The selected Runtime cannot run this agent. Choose Automatic or a compatible Runtime.
partial_location_inheritance: This location uses part of the bot default settings. Choose a location to override them.
